examples.detection_method: Deploy AI-aware email filters that analyze linguistic patterns for AI-generated text; correlate domain registration freshness and hosting IP reputation; monitor for deviations in normal email sending infrastructure with SPF/DKIM anomalies; user training including simulated AI-generated phishing emails; monitor network connections to newly registered domains with unusual TLS certificates and uncommon IP addresses.
